findings.needed_material: Complete the authorized preparation review in SC014 and provide record-level usability decisions and unresolved findings. Record usability and unresolved gaps must be established before fitting. Registered attachment bodies remain NOT_SEARCHED in this operation.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED. F0003:S1:T5:A51 identifies S02 and Table 1; B56:F65 contain isolate MICs and published parameters. MIC records are candidates for preparation, and parameter records can be retained with restricted reported status. A53-A54 establish that PD route is unstated and per-regimen CFU values are not transcribed. Treatment day, exposure assay, exposure matrix and individual experimental-unit identifiers are NOT_FOUND. No measured response records on this page are eligible for a new response-linked fit.
findings.needed_material: Independent preparation review confirming record-level uses and missing fields, with authorized source-backed exposure and response records if response-linked fitting is pursued.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED. A52-A53 describe neutropenic mice, intravenous inoculation and kidney endpoints, but explicitly leave PD administration route unstated. Oral gavage belongs to the referenced PK experiment. Mouse strain, treatment day, exposure matrix, exposure assay, dose formulation basis, grapefruit-juice exposure and co-medication status are NOT_FOUND. Unstated conditions cannot be treated as absent.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported PD route and relevant PK-to-PD biological correspondence, dose history, treatment day, matrix, assay and any proposed transfer or conversion justification before grouping or joining these records.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED. F0003:S1:T5:A52 names isolate K-1, whereas A56 identifies the table row as K1. The likely association has not been explicitly confirmed; identifiers must remain as supplied.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported confirmation or reviewed mapping between K-1 in the regimen note and K1 in the table before assigning that regimen design to the row.

findings.reason: AVAILABLE_CANDIDATE for preserving source evidence levels. A54 defines MICs as geometric mean of 3; D55:F65 contain reported parameters, and A66/F66 supply a Mean ± SD summary. These are not individual-animal observations. C63 is the comparator MIC >128 and must remain censored. A53 states detection limit 100 CFU/kidneys but supplies no associated CFU observations.
findings.needed_material: Preparation confirmation that summary rows, reported parameters, the comparator >128 value and the stated CFU detection limit remain distinct, without invented variability, animal IDs, observations or substitutions.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED input-use plan. D55:F65 and F66 provide published ED50s and exposure-index summaries. Their availability does not authorize their use to set primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors or rankings. This page provides no plan demonstrating those restrictions.
findings.needed_material: Documented segregation and permitted uses of published ED50 and AUC/MIC records, with independent sources for primary-analysis starting values, bounds, priors and ranking decisions.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED. Isolate MICs and reported total/free AUC/MIC values share table rows, but A54 explicitly says per-regimen CFU values are in figures only and not transcribed. The page supplies no measured regimen-level responses, free-exposure profiles or traceable regimen-exposure-response record set. Published ED50s cannot supply those missing measurements.
findings.needed_material: Authorized measured kidney-CFU response records with regimen identifiers, matched voriconazole isolate MICs, relevant free-exposure inputs, common windows and source-supported links. Keep candidiasis kidney-CFU records separate from survival endpoints.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED. A52 supplies inoculum, infection-to-treatment interval, immune status and variation in both total dose and dosing interval for K-1. Other isolates have a fixed every-6-h interval. A53 gives the kidney-CFU endpoint but no explicit K-1 treatment duration. Baseline/comparator reference, untreated growth-control observations, mouse strain, full PK-to-PD correspondence, MIC medium and inhibition endpoint are NOT_FOUND. Dose-fractionation metadata alone do not establish that indices can be distinguished.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported baseline or comparator, untreated controls, K-1 duration and response time, relevant host and PK correspondence, and missing MIC testing context. Preserve differing regimen designs and treatment windows for downstream assessment.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED. E55:F65 provide reported 24-h total/free AUC/MIC ratios. Exact AUC start/end and time origin, ratio units, underlying AUC values or concentration profiles, exposure estimation status, binding source and linkage to individual PD regimens are NOT_FOUND. The 24-h header does not establish a common matched analysis window.
findings.needed_material: Source-supported index definitions, units, time origin, relevant exposure/profile and binding inputs, and matched regimen-response relationships. If exposure reconstruction is a later T02 output, document that producer and dependency without treating it as already available.

findings.reason: UNRESOLVED effect definition and estimation inputs. A53 identifies change in log10 CFU per pair of kidneys, but does not define the change reference or desired effect magnitude. ED50 is reported without an explicit effect definition on this page. K-1 duration is unspecified, and no matched response observations support new target estimation. The uncomputed T04 target itself is a planned output rather than proof of missing source data.
findings.needed_material: Define the desired candidiasis kidney-CFU effect, baseline/comparator and endpoint window; provide or identify matched estimation inputs and the downstream target producer and uncertainty definition. Keep this target separate from survival and other organisms.
